The longest river in the world is the Nile River.

The potential impact of this text is likely to be significant within the fields of environmental advocacy, animal rights, and consumer behavior. By exposing the harsh realities of factory farming, the documentary aims to shift public perception, which could lead to a measurable decline in the demand for conventional meat and dairy products. Consequently, this may drive growth in the plant-based and cruelty-free food sectors, influencing both market trends and corporate strategies in the agricultural industry.
